name: feature_requests_list
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/feature_requests/
feature_requests_list
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: account_ids (query) — Accessible account IDs to include. Multiple values use OR semantics.; archive_state (query) — Whether to return active requests, archived requests, or all requests. * `active` - Active * `archived` - Archived * `all` - All; created_by_ids (query) — Creator user IDs to include. Multiple values use OR semantics.; limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.; priorities (query) — Priorities to include. Use none for requests without a priority.; product_area_ids (query) — Product area IDs to include. Multiple values use OR semantics.; request_ordering (query) — Stable ordering for the result list. * `-updated_at` - Last updated: newest * `updated_at` - Last updated: oldest * `-created_at` - Date created: newest * `created_at` - Date created: oldest * `-priority` - Priority: high to low * `priority` - Priority: low to high * `title` - Title: A to Z * `-title` - Title: Z to A * `account` - Accounts: A to Z * `-account` - Accounts: Z to A * `product_area` - Product areas: A to Z * `-product_area` - Product areas: Z to A * `status` - Status: A to Z * `-status` - Status: Z to A * `created_by` - Created by: A to Z * `-created_by` - Created by: Z to A * `evidence_count` - Evidence: low to high * `-evidence_count` - Evidence: high to low; search (query) — Case-insensitive text to find in request titles and descriptions.; statuses (query) — Lifecycle statuses to include. Multiple values use OR semantics.
